title: Oreo Cheesecake
style: Rich, creamy cookies-and-cream cheesecake with an Oreo crust.
description: A dense, creamy baked cheesecake studded with chopped Oreos on a buttery Oreo-crumb crust. Baked in a 9-inch springform and chilled until set.
steps: Crust: Mix the finely crushed Oreos with the melted butter. Press onto the bottom and about 2 inches up the side of a 9-inch springform pan.
Filling: Beat the cream cheese and sugar in a large bowl with a mixer until blended. Add the sour cream and vanilla; mix well.
Add the eggs one at a time, mixing on low speed after each just until blended — don't overbeat.
Stir in the coarsely chopped Oreos, then pour the batter into the crust.
Bake 55 minutes to 1 hour, until the centre is almost set.
Run a knife around the rim of the pan to loosen the cake, then cool before removing the rim.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.
tips: This uses 36 Oreos in total: 26 finely crushed for the crust and the remaining 10 coarsely chopped into the batter. In the UK that's about 3 packs, which leaves a few spare.
Room-temperature cream cheese and eggs blend smoothly and help avoid a lumpy batter.
Overbeating after adding the eggs whips in air that causes cracks — mix on low just until blended.
The centre should still wobble slightly when you take it out; it firms up as it chills.
For the cleanest set, chill overnight rather than the minimum 4 hours.
